newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A $100 million waste recycling plant to be built in Jeddah.
- Savola Company of Saudi Arabia replaced Danish partner in Egyptian cooking oil firm with a Malaysian partner.
- Saudi Arabia to tender 126 educational projects at a cost of 575 million riyals.
- Saudi Ceramics Company agreed to raise capital to 200 million riyals from 100 million riyals.
- Dammam mayor laid foundation stone for a 30 million riyal central market in Jubail.
